posts.title: Retiring enc.com.au

posts.title: WordPress 7.0.2 for Debian
posts.description: I have just uploaded WordPress version 7.0.2 for Debian. This fixes two serious security bugs CVE-2026-60137 and CVE-2026-63030. Chained together, this gives a RCE and is in active exploitation, so update as soon as its available. These two bugs are also in WordPress 6.9.x below 6.9.5 and the SQLi one (CVE-2026-60137) only is in 6.8.x […]
